title: Predeployment Attestation and Demo Security Appendix
body:
Purpose:

This appendix captures the pre-deployment attestation checklist, workshop notes, and a targeted evidence index prepared for the Granite Logistics proof-of-concept (POC) and live demo. It is intended to be used during the final security review prior to granting demo access or performing any customer-managed deployment validation. The document focuses on the set of artifacts we will present during the demo and the minimal set of controls Granite’s InfoSec team has requested for their acceptance criteria.

Executive summary:

- Customer: Granite Logistics (3PL freight partner) 
- POC scope: Hosted API + private VPC tunnel for a demo dataset containing pseudonymized shipment metadata. No production PII will be used during the demo.
- Ask from customer security: quick attestation of controls for network isolation, key management, access logging, and runtime fallback behavior if model variants fail.
- Outcome desired: demo access approval and an itemized evidence bundle so their audit team can perform a 48-hour pre-demo review.

High-level decisions made at workshop (2025-09-30):

1) Demo dataset will be synthetic and generated from Granite-provided schema; ingestion will occur over a customer-controlled SFTP to our staging ingest VPC (scoped, time-limited).
2) Private control-plane endpoint over VPC peering; we will provide temporary bastion jump-host for their security reviewer.
3) Encryption-in-transit: TLS 1.3 mandatory. Encryption-at-rest: server-side encryption with customer-managed KMS key (CMK) for dedicated sandbox instance.
4) Auditability: request/response logs retained for 7 days in a read-only bucket for the customer auditor.

Pre-deployment attestation checklist (attest value = planned / evidence_collected / follow-up):

- Identity & Access Management
  - Principle of least privilege applied to demo accounts: planned. Evidence collected: list of demo IAM roles (link below). Follow-up: lock down console access by 2025-10-10.
- Network isolation
  - VPC peering + security groups with single ingress CIDR: planned. Evidence collected: VPC peering config export. Follow-up: apply egress rules for third-party telemetry by 2025-10-06.
- Key management
  - Customer-provided CMK in KMS: planned. Evidence collected: KMS policy snapshot. Follow-up: rotate encryption keys after POC (2025-11-01).
- Data handling and minimization
  - Only pseudonymized shipment IDs used in demo: planned. Evidence collected: dataset generation script with sample output. Follow-up: Granite to sign attestation that dataset contains no live PII before demo.
- Logging & monitoring
  - Request/response and audit logs enabled, retention 7 days: planned. Evidence collected: logging policy excerpt and sample log. Follow-up: finalize retention SLA with SRE by 2025-10-07.
- Runtime fallback and graceful degradation
  - Canary model variant + fallback to smaller CPU-backed variant when GPU capacity exhausted: planned. Evidence collected: fallback config export. Follow-up: simulate capacity failure 2025-10-09.

Evidence index (artifact pointer, short description, status):

- demo-iam-roles.csv — CSV export of demo IAM roles and attached policies; status: collected (see linked_artifacts).
- vpc-peering-config.txt — exported VPC peering JSON; status: collected.
- kms-cmk-policy.txt — snippet of CMK policy showing Granite principal; status: collected.
- dataset-synth-script.py — python script used to generate pseudonymized shipments; status: collected.
- audit-logs-sample.txt — masked request/response sample; status: collected.
- fallback-policy.yaml — runtime rollout/fallback policy for canary and fallback variants; status: collected.
- network-harden-checklist.md — internal checklist completed by infra; status: in_review.

Note: all artifacts above are included in the evidence bundle and will be uploaded to the shared evidence folder at least 48 hours before the scheduled customer demo.

Mapping to common control frameworks (quick view):

- SOC 2 (CC2, CC6): IAM and change control evidence included (iam roles CSV, rollout policy).
- ISO 27001 (A.9, A.10): Access control and cryptography mapping in KMS policy and encryption notes.
- GDPR (Data minimization & pseudonymization): dataset-synth-script and attestation required from the customer.

Open questions and risks from the 2025-09-30 workshop:

1) Customer audit team asked for persistence proof that cached KV artifacts are not stored on disk after demo teardown. Risk: ephemeral caches currently flushed on instance shutdown; need signed runbook. Action: SRE to provide signed cache-flush runbook by 2025-10-05 (owner: Marcus Li).
2) Concern about function-calling during demo invoking external APIs. Risk: external calls could leak metadata. Action: block external egress from demo model instances; whitelist necessary control-plane endpoints (owner: Sofia Ramirez, due 2025-10-04).
3) Requirement for a dedicated network appliance for TLS inspection in their environment. Risk: integration may delay demo. Action: schedule engineering-level network run-through with Granite netops (owner: Ethan Cole) — target 2025-10-06.

Workshop notes (raw, rough):

- 09:10 — intro, customer use case: automated ETA and route reconciliation. Security ask: full auditability and KMS.
- 09:28 — SE demo plan: streaming tokens, function calls disabled initially, show embedding-based reranking.
- 09:44 — infra lead: can spin up ephemeral dedicated pool in us-west-2. Need sign-off to attach CMK.
- 10:02 — compliance: request for log TTL policy (answered: 7 days for demo, extendable).
- 10:18 — SRE: will run a capacity-failure sim in staging, invite Granite observer.
- 10:35 — action items captured (see Action items section).

Action items (owner — description — due):

- Marcus Li — produce signed cache-flush runbook and evidence of test run — 2025-10-05.
- Sofia Ramirez — implement egress block and produce whitelist of control-plane endpoints — 2025-10-04.
- Ethan Cole — run network integration call with Granite netops, capture packet-filtering diagram — 2025-10-06.
- Aisha Patel — assemble evidence bundle and upload to shared evidence folder, notify Granite security — 2025-10-08.
- Granite contact (M. Hollis) — sign dataset attestation that no PII is present — 2025-10-07.

Demo scenario script (keys to validate controls during live view):

1) Authentication & demo account creation flow 
   - Show limited demo IAM role being used to call the API. Verify audit log entry for the call.
2) Data ingest 
   - Upload synthetic CSV to SFTP, show controller acknowledging ingest, demonstrate ephemeral storage and subsequent deletion.
3) Model run with fallback sim 
   - Trigger multiple large-batch requests to provoke the canary fallback; show that fallback metric and subsequent audit log entries exist.
4) Log & artifact review 
   - Open masked audit log in read-only viewer, demonstrate retention policy.

Acceptance criteria for Granite security to greenlight demo access:

- KMS policy proves Granite control over CMK.
- VPC peering and security group exports show single ingress CIDR and no unexpected egress.
- Audit logs for demo account with required fields present for 7 days.
- Signed cache-flush runbook and evidence of cache purge test.
- Demonstrated fallback behavior in staging with observer present.

Appendix — quick artifact download locations (internal):

- Shared evidence folder: /shared_drives/security-and-compliance/granite-evidence-bundle/ (will be populated by 2025-10-08).
- Infra exports: /shared_drives/engineering/infrastructure/granite-vpc-exports/
- Runbooks: /shared_drives/engineering/site-reliability-engineering/runbooks/cache-flush-runbook.md

Notes to reviewer:

- This is intentionally scoped as a pre-deployment/demonstration attestation rather than a full compliance package. If Granite requests long-term deployment approval, we will convert this appendix into a formal evidence packet mapped to SOC 2 controls, and schedule a walkthrough with our security artifacts owner.
- Keep this doc as the single source of truth for the demo cut — updates should be small diffs and recorded in the Slack thread.

Document history (edits):

- 2025-09-12 — created initial draft (Aisha).
- 2025-09-30 — workshop notes appended and initial evidence list compiled (Aisha, Marcus, Sofia).
- 2025-10-02 — KMS policy snapshot added (Ethan).
- 2025-10-08 — final evidence upload plan and action items updated (Aisha).

End of appendix.
